The text also highlights that the main motivation for developing indicators is "simply to comply with central government regulations." Therefore, normative forces (professional standards) likely reinforce the *form* of the reporting (consistency) rather than the *substance* of local adaptation, potentially leading to a situation where KPIs reflect federal priorities (or the appearance of them) rather than unique local socioeconomic goals.
